name: chordino.js
description: Chord detection in the browser: the Chordino Vamp plugin, ported to C and compiled to WebAssembly, with a Web Worker for recordings, which also finds their beats, tempo and time signature, and an AudioWorklet feeding a Web Worker for live input, plus a live tuner
author: Francimar Alves <mazinsw@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/js/chord-worker.ts src/js/chord-live-worker.ts src/js/chord-processor.ts src/js/tuner-live-worker.ts --outdir=build --out-extension:.js=.mjs --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify && cp src/js/chordino.d.mts build/
scripts.lint:c: cd src && emcc -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Dkiss_fft_scalar=double nnls-chroma/*.c session.c spectrum.c window.c kissfft.c realtime.c vector.c pitch.c onset.c rhythm.c chordextract.c && emcc -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Dkiss_fft_scalar=double -DCHORDINO_INSPECT nnls-chroma/chordino.c inspect.c
